text:
I took my cat to the vet because he was limping on his left hind leg.
I told him where the cat was hurting.
They still took two X-rays, costing 800 baht.
If I had gone to the old vet, they would have informed me of the cost.
I would have just offered them one X-ray for 400 baht.
Because I had already explained the pain point.
If the X-rays didn't show anything, they wanted to do a blood test.
They didn't tell me the price, so I asked.
They said 900 baht, so I didn't do it.
The X-ray, examination, and medication cost 1170 baht.
If they added the blood test, it would have been over 2000 baht without even knowing what was wrong with my cat.
I'm opting out.
I gave 4 stars last time, but I'm reducing it this time; this is too much.

text:

They did very little wound care, and the diagnosis was inaccurate. The problem was the same area (other hospitals would have assessed it correctly), but they assessed it point by point. Their work was extremely sloppy; they didn't provide complete information and required constant questioning and follow-ups without informing the owner. They even made mistakes in calculating the bill, instead of refunding it. They also prescribed the wrong medication, wasting the owner's time multiple times. Seriously, this isn't a small place to live! Their work was incredibly shoddy. The medication was very cheap, like building a house, and they were completely careless. I'm not exaggerating. We discussed the costs beforehand, but the actual bill was many times higher than agreed upon. I spent a lot of money without any improvement. This hospital doesn't follow up on symptoms or provide any information; you have to ask. There was one doctor I recently encountered who was incredibly rude and wouldn't listen to the owner. They only offered bad excuses, even calling when the owner said it wasn't convenient. Their manners were terrible, and they lacked compassion despite their name. Terrible, the worst experience ever.
